UN Chief Guterres Criticizes Security Council, Calls for Peace

UN Secretary-General António Guterres has stated that global powers violating international law are part of the Security Council. He also called for renewed efforts to combat hate speech and promote peace and tolerance. Guterres made these remarks in coverage from The New Indian Express and The Tribune. The specific context or location of these statements was not provided in the coverage.
